tagline: It Came From Below — a submarine in black water that can only see by pinging
jam: TFS Jam Summer 2026, theme 'It Came From Below', web HTML5, <1GB, free
engine: Godot 4.7 GDScript, PORTRAIT 540x960, stretch canvas_items/expand, gl_compatibility, web-first

laws.growing_battery: each milestone adds suites; done = 2x consecutive green
laws.injectable_input: reuse C:\Users\aron\gyro-squadron-45 pattern — scripts/tilt_source.gd may be COPIED from gyro (pre-existing code is jam-legal) with touch-drag default on web
laws.original_assets: Flux sprites + procedural sonar audio (owned, generated in-house)

core_loop: glide through dark water; press SONAR: a radial ping briefly reveals terrain + creatures as bright echoes which FADE over ~2.5s; creatures rise from below toward noise; reach the depth goal then surface before air/pressure out

creatures.behavior: rises toward last ping origin, fast when close

survival.pressure: increases with depth, crushes hull below max_depth without upgrades

systems.goal: collect 3 wreck beacons at depth, then surface — run ends with score = beacons*1000 + depth record + air bonus

milestones: 1 SONAR CORE: darkness + ping reveal + echo fade + glide movement + battery
